svg.aria-label: Breast carcinoma precursor sequence: a normal duct with luminal and myoepithelial cells, atypical hyperplasia, DCIS with calcified comedo necrosis, and invasive ductal carcinoma crossing the basement membrane; below, ALH, LCIS with loss of E-cadherin, and invasive lobular carcinoma in single file
svg.text: From normal duct to invasive carcinoma
